_doc: Hand decisions for tools/state_towns.py (re-run it after editing; never hand-edit towns.tsv). Sources: Census Gazetteer 2023 places, popest 2023 (incorporated), Gazetteer 2010 POP10 (CDPs).
_regions: First match wins. islands = the Kodiak archipelago, the Aleutians and the Pribilofs; southeast = the Panhandle (Juneau, Sitka, Ketchikan, Yakutat); southcentral = Anchorage, Mat-Su, the Kenai Peninsula, Prince William Sound and the Copper River basin; interior = Fairbanks, the Tanana and middle Yukon valleys, Tok and McGrath. Everything else (North Slope, Northwest Arctic, Bering Strait, the Yukon-Kuskokwim Delta and Bristol Bay) is arctic_west.
_excludeCdp: Military posts (Eielson AFB, Fort Greely, Kodiak Station = Coast Guard base), a mine camp (Red Dog Mine), CDPs named after a bigger neighbouring town (Seldovia Village, Eagle Village), and road-named Fairbanks/Mat-Su suburb tracts that read as subdivisions (Badger, Steele Creek, Chena Ridge, Farmers Loop, Farm Loop, Gateway, Buffalo Soapstone).
_keepCdp: Real places hidden by the hyphen/drop-word filter (Knik-Fairview, Sutton, South Naknek) and Denali Park (CDP new since 2010, no 2010 population; the park entrance community).
_rename: Sutton-Alpine CDP -> Sutton (the community is known as Sutton; Alpine is a small subdivision). LSAD suffixes (city and borough, municipality) are stripped by the tool.
